findings.title: Scope of Work and Deliverables Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the products and services that fall under the agreement, which constitutes the scope of work.
evidence_excerpts: The following products and services fall under this Agreement: Enterprise Servers (Rack-mounted, Blade, Tower), Networking Equipment (Switches, Firewalls, Routers), Data Storage Solutions (NAS, SAN, Cloud-integrated Storage), Workstation and Peripheral Devices (UPS, Printers, Scanners, Monitors), Consumables (Cables, Batteries, Connectors), Extended Warranty and Maintenance Services.
